items.title: Issy – AI-native issue tracking stored as Markdown files in your repo
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN, I built issy, a lightweight issue tracker that stores issues as markdown files in a `.issues/` directory in your repo. The idea is simple: issues should live with your code. They show up in diffs, travel with branches, and don't require accounts, databases, or external services. They're just markdown files with YAML frontmatter. It's built for AI coding assistants. You can tell Cursor/Claude/Codex (or any AI agent) things like "create a bug for the login redirect issue, high priority" and it handles the rest — creating, searching, updating, and closing issues through natural language. There's a Cursor skill you can install with `npx skills add miketromba/issy`. It also comes with a CLI for filtering/searching and a local web UI at localhost:1554 for when you want a visual overview.

To this day, the tech community has yet to establish a standard definition for "world models." However, this has not stopped it from becoming the most compelling narrative of the moment: in the eyes of VCs, it is the ultimate sandbox for validating business closed loops; in the field of embodied intelligence, it serves as the predictive brain that enables robots to "think three steps ahead"; and amidst the ruins of the metaverse, it is seen as the final piece of the puzzle for transitioning information carriers from 2D videos to 3D interactive worlds. items.raw_excerpt: 2026年春节前夕，围绕AI展开的“红包大战”持续升温。流量高峰之下，真正的胜负开始体现在用户规模与使用深度上。最新数据显示，百度文心凭借四倍增长的月活，率先确立AI入口优势。   2月10日，百度文心公布数据：自春节红包活动启动以来，文心助手MAU同比增长4倍；其中，生图功能调用量同比增长50倍，生视频功能同比增长40倍，AI打电话功能增长近4倍。多项核心能力的同步爆发，意味着用户使用正从节日驱动的尝鲜体验，转向高频、真实场景下的持续使用。       增长背后，是产品路径的结构性升级。百度没选择单独打造新入口，而是将文心助手深度整合进百度App与搜索主入口，用户无需下载即可轻松使用文心助手AI能力。   例如，当用户在百度搜索“春节红包攻略”“年夜饭菜谱”“拜年话术”等内容时，文心助手会直接生成step-by-step答案、详细菜谱，甚至帮用户“打电话”给长辈送祝福。这种“搜索即AI”的无痛转场，让AI从尝鲜工具变成了解决问题的第一选择。   不同AI产品对“中国AI入口有哪些”的回答   更重要的是，依托20多年搜索能力积累，百度在理解用户意图与结果校验方面具备天然优势。相比单纯生成式回答，“搜索+生成”的双重机制，使内容可信度更高，在一定程度上降低了大模型“幻觉”风险。这种底层能力差异，成为用户留存与高频使用的重要基础。   高盛指出，百度是最被低估的AI流量入口。若未来搜索流量进一步向订酒店、购票等服务场景转化，百度AI业务估值仍具30%以上的上行空间。   在巩固AI入口优势的同时，百度也在加速夯实底层能力与生态布局。近期，百度智能云推出对热门开源AI Agent“OpenClaw”的一键部署方案，推动开发者与企业加速落地智能体，展现出在AI基础设施与生态开放方面的战略领先

excerpt_i18n.zh: 2026年春节前夕，围绕AI展开的“红包大战”持续升温。流量高峰之下，真正的胜负开始体现在用户规模与使用深度上。最新数据显示，百度文心凭借四倍增长的月活，率先确立AI入口优势。   2月10日，百度文心公布数据：自春节红包活动启动以来，文心助手MAU同比增长4倍；其中，生图功能调用量同比增长50倍，生视频功能同比增长40倍，AI打电话功能增长近4倍。多项核心能力的同步爆发，意味着用户使用正从节日驱动的尝鲜体验，转向高频、真实场景下的持续使用。       增长背后，是产品路径的结构性升级。百度没选择单独打造新入口，而是将文心助手深度整合进百度App与搜索主入口，用户无需下载即可轻松使用文心助手AI能力。   例如，当用户在百度搜索“春节红包攻略”“年夜饭菜谱”“拜年话术”等内容时，文心助手会直接生成step-by-step答案、详细菜谱，甚至帮用户“打电话”给长辈送祝福。这种“搜索即AI”的无痛转场，让AI从尝鲜工具变成了解决问题的第一选择。   不同AI产品对“中国AI入口有哪些”的回答   更重要的是，依托20多年搜索能力积累，百度在理解用户意图与结果校验方面具备天然优势。相比单纯生成式回答，“搜索+生成”的双重机制，使内容可信度更高，在一定程度上降低了大模型“幻觉”风险。这种底层能力差异，成为用户留存与高频使用的重要基础。   高盛指出，百度是最被低估的AI流量入口。若未来搜索流量进一步向订酒店、购票等服务场景转化，百度AI业务估值仍具30%以上的上行空间。   在巩固AI入口优势的同时，百度也在加速夯实底层能力与生态布局。近期，百度智能云推出对热门开源AI Agent“OpenClaw”的一键部署方案，推动开发者与企业加速落地智能体，展现出在AI基础设施与生态开放方面的战略领先
excerpt_i18n.en:
On the eve of the 2026 Spring Festival, the "red envelope battle" centered around AI continues to intensify. Amid peak traffic, the true outcome is beginning to manifest in user scale and depth of usage. Latest data shows that Baidu's Wenxin has taken the lead in establishing an AI gateway advantage, with a fourfold increase in monthly active users. On February 10, Baidu Wenxin released data: since the launch of the Spring Festival red envelope campaign, Wenxin Assistant's MAU has grown fourfold year-over-year; among its features, image generation calls increased 50-fold, video generation calls rose 40-fold, and AI phone call functionality grew nearly fourfold. The simultaneous surge in multiple core capabilities indicates that user engagement is shifting from festival-driven trial experiences to sustained, high-frequency usage in real-world scenarios.

Behind this growth lies a structural upgrade in product strategy. Instead of creating a standalone new gateway, Baidu deeply integrated Wenxin Assistant into the Baidu App and its primary search interface, allowing users to easily access Wenxin Assistant's AI capabilities without downloading additional apps. For example, when users search for content like "Spring Festival red envelope tips," "New Year's Eve dinner recipes," or "New Year greeting phrases" on Baidu, Wenxin Assistant directly generates step-by-step answers, detailed recipes, or even helps users "make calls" to elders to send blessings. This seamless "search as AI" transition has turned AI from a novelty tool into the first choice for problem-solving.

More importantly, leveraging over 20 years of search technology accumulation and massive user data, Baidu has built a robust foundation for AI applications.
excerpt_i18n.es: En vísperas de la Fiesta de la Primavera de 2026, la "batalla de los sobres rojos" centrada en la IA continúa intensificándose. Bajo el pico de tráfico, la verdadera victoria comienza a reflejarse en la escala de usuarios y la profundidad de uso. Los últimos datos muestran que Baidu Wenxin, con un crecimiento cuádruple en usuarios activos mensuales, ha establecido ventaja como puerta de entrada a la IA. El 10 de febrero, Baidu Wenxin reveló cifras: desde el inicio de la campaña de sobres rojos, los MAU del asistente Wenxin aumentaron 4 veces interanual; entre ellas, las llamadas a la función de generación de imágenes crecieron 50 veces, la de generación de videos 40 veces, y la función de llamadas telefónicas con IA casi 4 veces. La explosión simultánea de múltiples capacidades clave indica que el uso por parte de los usuarios está pasando de experiencias impulsadas por festividades a escenarios frecuentes y reales.

items.raw_excerpt: 众所周知，Transformer 及其核心的全注意力机制（Full Attention）虽长期占据大模型架构的核心地位，但平方级计算复杂度、高额显存占用的瓶颈，早已成为实现超长上下文处理与模型规模化应用的 “拦路虎”。敢于挑战这一固有权威，需要的不仅是实现 AGI 长远目标勇于创新的魄力，更需要有独到的技术视野以及突破技术壁垒的硬实力。从 DeepSeek 的稀疏注意力（DSA）、MiniMax 的线性注意力、到月之暗面的线性注意力（KDA），大家纷纷投入注意力架构的革新竞技场。 今天，面壁智能也在这场变革中迈出了关键一步：正式发布行业首个大规模训练的稀疏-线性注意力混合架构 SALA（Sparse Attention-Linear Attention，简称SALA），以及基于该架构的文本模型 MiniCPM-SALA，以追求更长文本处理能力与极致的推理性价比。MiniCPM-SALA 不仅在多项长文本理解与生成评测中优势明显，且在知识问答、数学推理、代码生成等核心能力维度上，保持了与同规模全注意力模型相当的卓越水平，实现了“长短兼备”的综合性能表现，以及极致推理性价比。 ▍MiniCPM-SALA 亮点一览  ▪ 架构革新：“稀疏-线性”注意力混合架构，在显著降低推理开销与显存占用的同时，克服了纯线性架构在长程信息召回上的精度瓶颈，效率性能兼顾。 ▪ 卓越性能：采用HyPE（混合位置编码）来有效协调短上下文和长上下文的性能。在保持通用能力（如知识、数学和编码）与其他8B全注意力模型相当的同时，MiniCPM-SALA 在多个长上下文基准测试中表现出明显优势。 ▪ 高效推理：不使用投机采样等加速算法，在云端推理芯片上，当序列长度为256K词元时推理速度高达 Qwen3-8B 的 3.5 倍，并支持在云端芯片和消费级端侧 GPU 上进行

excerpt_i18n.en: As is well known, although the Transformer and its core full attention mechanism have long dominated the architecture of large models, the bottlenecks of quadratic computational complexity and high memory consumption have long been obstacles to achieving ultra-long context processing and large-scale model applications. Challenging this established authority requires not only the innovative courage to pursue the long-term goal of AGI but also unique technical vision and the hard capabilities to break through technical barriers. From DeepSeek's sparse attention (DSA) and MiniMax's linear attention to MoonShot AI's linear attention (KDA), many have entered the competitive arena of attention architecture innovation. Today, ModelBest has taken a crucial step in this transformation: officially releasing the industry's first large-scale trained sparse-linear attention hybrid architecture, SALA (Sparse Attention-Linear Attention), along with the text model MiniCPM-SALA based on this architecture, aiming for longer text processing capabilities and extreme reasoning cost-effectiveness. MiniCPM-SALA not only demonstrates clear advantages in multiple evaluations of long-text understanding and generation but also maintains excellent performance comparable to full-attention models of the same scale in core capabilities such as knowledge question answering, mathematical reasoning, and code generation, achieving comprehensive performance that excels in both short and long contexts, along with extreme reasoning cost-effectiveness. ▍MiniC
excerpt_i18n.es: Es bien sabido que, aunque el Transformer y su mecanismo central de atención completa han ocupado durante mucho tiempo una posición central en la arquitectura de los grandes modelos, el cuello de botella de la complejidad computacional cuadrática y el alto consumo de memoria de video se ha convertido en un obstáculo para el procesamiento de contextos ultralargos y la aplicación escalable de modelos. Desafiar esta autoridad inherente requiere no solo el coraje innovador para perseguir el objetivo a largo plazo de la AGI, sino también una visión técnica única y la capacidad sólida para superar las barreras tecnológicas. Desde la atención dispersa de DeepSeek y la atención lineal de MiniMax, hasta la atención lineal de Dark Side of the Moon.
